passages.provision_quote: That Section 31 of Article I thereof is repealed.
passages.note: The operative clause repeals the Prop 209 ban on race/sex preferences; it permits but does not mandate affirmative action, so it shows direction against rung 5 without matching another rung's full clauses.
Ramos voted Aye on ACA 5's single-subject Assembly floor passage, a repeal that only permits race-conscious programs rather than mandating or enforcing equity.

rows.reasoning: Ramos voted Aye on ACA 5 (2019-2020), whose operative text only repeals the constitutional ban on race- and sex-based preferences ('That Section 31 of Article I thereof is repealed'), permitting affirmative-action programs again rather than mandating equity requirements or strengthening enforcement. Per the annex, a measure that only permits a programme strengthens no enforcement, so it establishes at most the 'address systemic discrimination' side of rung 2 ('strengthen civil rights enforcement and address systemic discrimination'), leaving the enforcement clause unevidenced.
